text:
sarah.partnerships: Ok team — kicking off a short sync for cloud marketplace onboarding (AWS / GCP / Azure). We need a crisp checklist: legal artifacts, SKU + packaging, AMI/VM image reqs, billing dimension mapping, and launch comms. Target: initial public listing by end of Q2. @dan.legal @emma.product @leo.aws-liaison

emma.product: thanks — quick Q: do we want a single SKU per edition (starter/pro/enterprise) or multiple SKUs per region/instance-type?

tom.bizdev: recommend single SKU per edition, and let billing dimensions handle instance/usage. simpler for marketplace listings. :+1:

dan.legal: high level legal checklist I need: EULA template, DPA, export control review, and any marketplace-specific terms (AWS/Google have extras). I can recycle our existing EULA but need confirmation of data flow and KMS responsibilities.

jared.security: confirm data flow: hosted API will call customer VPC for Private deployments? For hosted listings we must state where logs/metrics land. Also need SOC2 cert copy + network diagrams for AWS listing.

leo.aws-liaison: AWS note: for AMI-based listings we require signed manifest, product code, and a subscription pricing plan. For ML products we often use SaaS subscriptions too — both are allowed but different onboarding forms. I'll attach AWS partner checklist.

maya.ops: from ops side: AMI build pipeline should produce immutable AMIs per release, tag with version and date, and publish to partner account. Need build automation docs and a quick runbook for rollback.

ryan.eng: engineering blockers: packaging the inference runtime as an AMI is straightforward but we need to capture GPU driver licensing and image size limits. Also we should include a startup script that validates NVidia driver + CUDA version. Example startup snippet: 

```
#!/bin/bash
# simple runtime validator
nvidia-smi || { echo "gpu missing"; exit 1; }
python3 -c "import torch; print(torch.cuda.is_available())" || exit 1
```

helen.pm: Nice. For product pages we need a concise description, 3 screenshots, and a short usage example. Also a clear differentiation table vs Hosted API offering.

emma.product: SKU template (please copy/paste into the marketplace portal):
```
sku_id: RWI-CORE-PRO
title: Redwood Inference — Core Pro
pricing_model: subscription
billing_units: monthly
price_usd: 499
features: ["dedicated GPU pool","priority support","SLA 99.9%"]
```

sarah.partnerships: Great. Action items so we don't lose track: 
- dan.legal: draft marketplace addendum + confirm if any region-specific language is required (owner: dan.legal)
- emma.product: finalize SKU list, descriptions, screenshots (owner: emma.product)
- ryan.eng & maya.ops: AMI build runbook + startup validation + publish automation (owners: ryan.eng, maya.ops)
- leo.aws-liaison: share AWS partner checklist and contact for listing review (owner: leo.aws-liaison)
- jared.security: provide SOC2 artifact and network diagram (owner: jared.security)
- tom.bizdev & helen.pm: draft launch comms + pricing page copy (owners: tom.bizdev, helen.pm)

marketplace-bot: Created ticket MP-421 in Jira: https://rwd.atl/jira/MP-421 :spiral_calendar:

dan.legal: I'll throw a first draft into MP-421 by EOD Thursday. If anyone has precedent clauses (marketplace-specific) paste them here.

tom.bizdev: I'll prep a short partner announcement plan but need to confirm if we do coordinated press with AWS — @sarah.partnerships any thoughts?

sarah.partnerships: Yes, let's aim for coordinated announcement if AWS wants it. Leo — can you flag if partner marketing co-announcement is possible for our tier?

leo.aws-liaison: I'll check with partner marketing and loop back by Friday. Usually possible for Advanced partners but need assets + legal signoff.

emma.product: Uploading draft screenshots + short desc to the drive: https://rwd.drive/redwood-marketplace-assets (still WIP).

ryan.eng: note: for GCP marketplace the image format is different (image family) — I'll add a short section in the runbook about GCP vs AWS differences.

maya.ops: ops will tag AMIs as rwi-prod-<version>-<date> and publish to partner account once we have legal signoff. I'll add the runbook to MP-421.

jared.security: sharing SOC2 report link privately with Leo and legal. Will add minimal network diagram here for public listing.

helen.pm: timeline check: can everyone aim to have their deliverables in MP-421 by next Wednesday? we can then schedule a final review with partner marketing the week after.

sarah.partnerships: Perfect. If no objections I'll lock the checklist and move this to a recurring weekly 30m until launch. Thanks all. :rocket:
